channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Zelenskyy has no cards to play against Russia or the West
item.description: Ukraine's president struggles to secure gains for a peaceful resolution. The president seems unable to secure for Ukrainian people a gain that can compensate for a painful peace. Zelenskyy has no cards to play against Russia or the West.

item.title: Iran proposes end to war within 30 days as Trump expresses doubts - The Tribune-Democrat
item.description: Iran proposes a 30-day end to war amidst Trump's doubts. Iran proposes end to war within 30 days as Trump expresses doubts The Tribune-Democrat. Iran proposes end to war within 30 days as Trump expresses doubts - The Tribune-Democrat.

item.title: Concern for jailed Iranian Nobel laureate as brother fears she is dying
item.description: Iranian Nobel laureate's health sharply deteriorates in prison. Her family said the 54-year-old had been taken from prison to a local hospital after a sharp deterioration in her health. Concern for jailed Iranian Nobel laureate as brother fears she is dying.

item.title: ‘Wartime Relic’ Explodes Under Campfire in Austria, Injuring Five Children
item.description: Five children were injured in Austria when a wartime relic exploded. The children, aged 10 to 14, were taken to a hospital for treatment after the explosion in Upper Austria, the police said.

item.title: Two US service members reported missing in Morocco, officials say
item.description: Two US service members are missing in Morocco, a search is underway. A search and rescue operation is underway for the service members, the US African Command said. Two US service members reported missing in Morocco, officials say.

item.title: Trump reviewing Iran peace proposal as deadline for congressional authorization passes
item.description: US President Trump is reviewing an Iran peace proposal as the deadline for congressional authorization passes. The proposal aims to ease sanctions on Iran in exchange for limits on its nuclear program.

item.title: 2 US service members missing after military exercises in Morocco
item.description: Two US service members are missing after military exercises in Morocco. The incident occurred during a joint training operation with the Moroccan military. 2 US service members missing after military exercises in Morocco.

item.title: Cheap, Invisible, Accurate: Hezbollah's Deadly New Weapon Against Israel
item.description: Hezbollah has developed a new drone technology capable of evading detection. The Israeli Defense Forces have responded by deploying nets and physical barriers to intercept incoming drones. The IDF has responded by deploying nets and physical barriers to intercept incoming drones.

item.title: Russian strikes kill 10 as Zelensky says Ukraine hits oil tankers and terminal
item.description: Russian strikes in Ukraine killed 10 people, according to reports. Zelensky said Ukraine's drones hit Russian oil tankers and a terminal, but the extent of the damage is unclear. Fatalities have been reported around Ukraine as Kyiv says Russian "shadow fleet" tankers were hit by drones.

item.title: Iran says U.S. military operation ‘impossible’ as Trump mulls peace proposal
item.description: US President Donald Trump faces a choice between a military operation deemed impossible by Iran's intelligence organisation and a peace proposal, according to a state television post. The Islamic Republic of Iran has presented a proposal to Trump, who must decide on a course of action.

item.title: US to cut troops in Germany as Iran war spat deepens
item.description: The US plans to cut troops in Germany amid a deepening spat between President Trump and Chancellor Merz over the war on Iran. The move strains US-German relations, with tensions escalating between the two nations.

item.title: Trump says he is likely to reject peace proposal as Iran has 'not yet paid a big enough price'
item.description: US President Donald Trump has expressed doubts about an Iranian peace proposal, saying Iran has not yet paid a big enough price. Trump's comments suggest he may reject the proposal, which has been presented by the Iranian government.

item.title: Iran executes man convicted of killing security officer in 2022
item.description: Iran has executed a man convicted of killing a security officer in 2022. The execution was carried out despite international calls for a moratorium on capital punishment. Iran executes man convicted of killing security officer in 2022.

item.title: OPEC+ announces symbolic oil output rise during Strait of Hormuz closure
item.description: OPEC+ has announced a symbolic increase in oil output during the Strait of Hormuz closure. Seven major producers will add 188,000 barrels per day to their total production quota for June.

item.title: Tallest for nearly 25 years, now ranked 25th
item.description: The Sears Tower, completed in 1973, held the title of world's tallest building for nearly 25 years before being surpassed. Now ranked 25th, the tower remains a notable landmark in Chicago, with its height still a subject of urban legend.

item.title: Trump says Iran has not yet ‘paid a big enough price’ as he reviews new peace plan
item.description: Trump reviewed a new peace plan and said Iran has not paid a big enough price. Trump says Iran has not yet ‘paid a big enough price’ as he reviews new peace plan.

item.title: OPEC+ hikes oil production quotas without mentioning UAE pull-out
item.description: OPEC+ raised oil production quotas without mentioning the UAE's potential withdrawal, a move that may not impact actual production. But raising the quota on paper may not have much impact on actual production, which is already short of the limit.

item.title: How Serbia's government dominates the country's media
item.description: Serbia's government has tightened its grip on the media since 2012, sparking fears of further restrictions ahead of an election. Since Serbia's ruling SNS party came to power in 2012, it has tightened its grip on the media.

item.title: 'Impossible Operation Or Bad Deal': Iran Guards' 2 Options For Trump
item.description: Iran has kept the Strait of Hormuz largely closed after US actions. Iran has kept the key Strait of Hormuz largely closed. 'Impossible Operation Or Bad Deal': Iran Guards' 2 Options For Trump.

item.title: Asian Development Bank offers help to Pacific countries hit by Iran war
item.description: The Asian Development Bank is offering aid to Pacific countries affected by the Iran conflict. Asian Development Bank offers help to Pacific countries hit by Iran war.
